_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Thursday — frontier-model release day of W16; the largest model-launch day in the window so far. (1) Anthropic ships Claude Opus 4.7 GA — 3× higher vision resolution (2576px/3.75MP), 'xhigh' effort tier, task budgets, new tokenizer (~35% more tokens for same text); day-one in Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise, API, Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot. (2) OpenAI launches GPT-Rosalind — first vertical model — life-sciences trusted-access program with Amgen/Moderna/Allen Institute/Thermo Fisher/Novo Nordisk; Glasswing template replicated. (3) Cloudflare Agents Week day-4 ships Agent Memory (private beta) + Project Think next-gen Agents SDK + Artifacts versioned storage + Browser Run HITL. (4) ServiceNow embeds Anthropic Claude as default Build Agent model — not OpenAI, not Gemini — biggest enterprise-stack standardisation in the Anthropic playbook to date. (5) SAP Business AI Q1 2026 highlights — 30+ Joule agents + 2,500+ Joule Skills + Tender Analysis Agent for Sapphire May 12–13. Adjacent: Anthropic Mythos→UK-banks delivery within next week (BoE CISO group); Qwen3.6-35B-A3B beats Opus on Willison's pelican; GLM-5.1 carries. Research: OccuBench, Sema Code, SemaClaw, TREX, Exploration/Exploitation Errors, Memory Transfer Learning, UI-Copilot, MERRIN, KV Packet. STAGE MOVES: none — signals broadening, not transitioning.
